name: Penelope N. Bach
tagline: Top rated Bankruptcy attorney in Northbrook, Illinois
side_practice_areas: Bankruptcy, Creditor Debtor Rights, Real Estate
about: With over 20 years of experience practicing law, Penelope N. Bach has cemented her reputation as a stalwart advocate for her clients, fighting tooth and nail to help them overcome the difficult financial challenges they face in their lives. The owner of Bach Law Offices, Inc., in Northbrook, Illinois, she handles complex bankruptcy cases related to Chapter 7, 11 and 13, and uses all the legal and practical knowledge she has accumulated to give her clients a second chance to start anew.

Ms. Bach completed her undergraduate studies in 1992, graduating with her Bachelor of Science degree in elementary education and teaching from Drake University. She went on to enroll in the DePaul University College of Law, where she strengthened her legal acumen and talents through her active involvement on campus. She received her Juris Doctor in 2005, and in the same year, she obtained her license to practice law in Illinois. Later on, she gained admission to practice before the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Northern District of Illinois and the United States Court of Appeals for the 7th Circuit.

A consummate professional through and through, Ms. Bach understands the enormous stress her clients are under, and she uses all the legal tools in her arsenal to alleviate their worries and provide the confidence that their cases are in capable hands. For her many contributions, she has been rated “Excellent” on Avvo and hosts myriad positive client testimonials on the site as well.

Within her legal community, Ms. Bach holds close affiliations with many legal organizations, including the American Bar Association, the American Bankruptcy Institute and the National Association of Consumer Advocates.
honors: Illinois Rising Stars Award of Excellence
